| P2 | app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:144 | Add cases for same-length subdomains (for example, `www.example.com` versus `forum.example.com`) and an unrelated same-length domain, because this host/path branch is currently untested. | testing | 0.97 |

| P2 | app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/user/user.hbs:66 | Add a profile-rendering test covering the new `model.website_name` link/span and the blank or malformed website path, since serializer-only tests cannot catch template wiring or visibility regressions. | testing | 0.94 |

goldens.comment: The include_website_name method is missing the required ? suffix. Rails serializers expect include_ methods to end with ? for conditional attribute inclusion, a convention followed by other methods in this serializer. Without it, the website_name attribute may not be conditionally included as intended. Additionally, the '.' << website_host string concatenation should be replaced with '.' + website_host or '.#{website_host}' to avoid mutating string literals, which can lead to issues.

adjudication_records.issue_text: | P2 | app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:144 | Add cases for same-length subdomains (for example, `www.example.com` versus `forum.example.com`) and an unrelated same-length domain, because this host/path branch is currently untested. | testing | 0.97 |

adjudication.rationale: The finding claims the same-length subdomain branch (lines 143-145) is untested, but the diff shows a test at line 87-89 that tests exactly this case: 'returns complete website path when website domain is parent of instance domain' with 'forums.example.com' as the hostname and 'example.com/user' as the website. This tests the scenario where discourse_host.ends_with?('.' << website_host) is true. The test coverage for the middle branch (www.example.com vs forum.example.com) is indeed missing, but the finding incorrectly states the branch is 'currently untested' when partial testing exists.

adjudication_records.issue_text: | P2 | app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/user/user.hbs:66 | Add a profile-rendering test covering the new `model.website_name` link/span and the blank or malformed website path, since serializer-only tests cannot catch template wiring or visibility regressions. | testing | 0.94 |

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows new template logic in user.hbs that conditionally renders website_name as either a link or span based on linkWebsite. While the serializer has tests for website_name computation, there are no template/integration tests added to verify the template correctly wires up model.website_name and handles edge cases like blank values. The finding correctly identifies that serializer tests alone cannot catch template binding issues. This is a legitimate testing gap for newly added nontrivial UI logic.
